title: Seven Twenty-Seven
targetsNote: Two targets: 7 and 27. Go over and that side is out. Face cards are 0.5, an ace is 1 or 11.

roundResult.title: Round result
roundResult.carry: Everyone busted both ways. Pot {{pot}} carries over (carry #{{count}})
roundResult.lowEmpty: Low (7): nobody survived — high takes it all
roundResult.highEmpty: High (27): nobody survived — low takes it all

hintReasonChaseSeven: only the low side is alive and you are short of 7, so draw
hintReasonChaseTwentySeven: you are chasing 27 and still short, so draw
hintReasonExactlySeven: exactly 7 — drawing can only break it
hintReasonExactlyTwentySeven: exactly 27 — drawing can only break it
hintReasonStandPat: standing is safer here; one card could put you over
hintReasonBustBoth: you are over on both sides; drawing gains nothing
